# No title: page 1 holds only the three lists (M115-AC1).
format: typst
filters:
  - index
---

```{=typst}
#outline(title: [List of Figures], target: figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-fig"))
#outline(title: [List of Tables], target: figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-tbl"))
#outline(title: [List of Listings], target: figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-lst"))
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

The fixture for marks in a caption that a Typst list copies (M115). Typst's
`outline` copies the caption of each float it lists, so a label written in a
caption names a second element on the list's page. Page 1 holds only the three
lists, with no title above them, and the same three lists follow the last caption, so a locator that
names the list's page is wrong whether the list comes first or last.

Every case ends in an explicit page break, so the page each mark sits on is a
fact of this source: page 1 is the lists' page, and each break starts the next.
No term, caption or list title holds the letters `f` and `i`, `f` and `l`, two
`f`s, or two `!`s in a row, which the Typst floor sets as one glyph.
